title: feat(ui): open field history on the CRM's four main objects; the timeline's Changes chip follows trackHistory
body:
Fixes #30074

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** CRM 示例的线索、客户、联系人、商机四个对象打开了 `enable.trackHistory`，记录页的动态里能看到每次字段修改的旧值和新值；没有打开它的对象，动态页签上不再出现「变更」筛选。
- **为什么改：** 按裁决 A（6631104393）：示例示范正确做法，标志保持按需开启，默认开启不在本次决定。
- **风险与回滚：** 风险低：只改示例对象的一个标志和一个筛选的显示条件，不改数据、不改接口；回滚即撤销本 PR。注意：未开启历史的对象，系统活动里的「更新了…」「创建了…」行原本也落在「变更」下，现在只能在「全部」里看到（见 Acceptance notes）。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx`（选中的筛选被拿掉时回到「全部」）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/recordTimelineStream.ts`（新的上下文与筛选列表）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（把 `historyEnabled` 交给动态）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`，预期全部通过；或 `pnpm dev:crm` 后打开一条商机，改赢单概率，再打开动态页签：有「变更」筛选，点开能看到「赢单概率 70 → 75」。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **CRM example.** `crm_lead`, `crm_account`, `crm_contact` and `crm_opportunity` declare `enable: { trackHistory: true }` (none of the four had an `enable` block). These are the four object entries of the CRM app's Sales navigation other than `crm_activity`, which is the activity log itself; `crm_opportunity_line_item` is a child of the opportunity and has no navigation entry. Every other object stays opt-in.
- **Where the Changes chip is drawn.** The chip is not drawn by `RecordDetailView.tsx`: the 动态 stream's chips are rendered by `RecordActivityTimeline` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, with the chip state held in the `record:activity` renderer. So the fix lands there, and the host only hands over its gate:
  - `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: new `RecordFieldHistoryContext` (boolean, default `true`, so a host that says nothing keeps every chip) and `timelineStreamFilters(fieldHistory)`. The `record:activity` stream reads the context; while it is `false` it offers All / Activity / Discussion only, and a stream left on Changes falls back to All. `RecordActivityTimeline` takes the chips to draw as `streamFilters` (all four when absent).
  - `@object-ui/app-shell`: `RecordDetailView` provides `RecordFieldHistoryContext` with its existing `historyEnabled` (the object declares `enable.trackHistory: true` and `sys_audit_log` is registered), the same gate that decides whether it reads the audit log.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md` says the Changes chip follows the record's field history. Root changeset `.changeset/30074-crm-track-history.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch; `app-shell` and the CRM example are private).

File surface: the claim declared the four object files, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, their tests and one changeset. Outside it, by necessity: four `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src` files (the chip's real renderer, as the dispatch allowed), the plugin-detail README (ui rule: docs follow code).

## Tests

All runs on head `8c5b89c91` (the final commit; nothing pushed after them).

- New pins, `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`, a top-level describe in the existing harness: history shown gives four chips; history not shown gives three and All still draws every entry; no provider gives four (control); Changes taken away while chosen leaves the stream on All.
- New pins, `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx`, a top-level describe: a real `RecordDetailView` mount on `?related=timeline` draws all / activity / discussion / changes for a `trackHistory` object, and all / activity / discussion with zero audit reads for the same object without it.
- Ablation (one, on the context read in `record-activity.tsx`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the subject resolves to `src` through `ui/vitest.config.mts` aliases): anchor 1 to 0, blob `7b5fe9176ec0` to `69e1bc36c51c`; 3 tests red (the two plugin-detail "not shown" pins and the app-shell "without it" pin), the "shown" and control pins green; restored, blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's premise that the Changes chip can show nothing is only partly true.** Without `trackHistory`, the stream's Changes chip is not empty: `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE` maps `sys_activity` `created` / `updated` / `deleted` / `assigned` / `shared` rows to the `field_change` feed type, and `filterTimelineStream(…, 'changes')` keeps them (the existing pin "the four chips" in `recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx` holds an activity `created` row under Changes). So on an object without history, the "更新了 …：赢单概率 (%)" lines used to be reachable under Changes and are now reachable only under All (the Activity chip leaves `field_change` out). This PR does what the ruling says; whether such rows should also show under Activity when Changes is hidden is left to the seat and the maintainer.
- `main` moved 8 commits past the base `55337f4ce` before the PR opened; none touches a path in this diff, so the branch was not re-merged. CI runs the merge ref.
- Not measured here: a live browser run of the CRM (the pins mount the real `RecordDetailView`).
